noise_config.forward_model: B_clean = sum_xy P_i(x,y) O(x,y) (unchanged Phase 2A physics)

noise_model.photon_scale: s = N_ph / mu_ref; mu_ref = mean clean bucket over the 341 training images, seed-2026 patterns (a fixed constant for all images)
noise_model.detector_noise: e ~ Normal(0, kappa * sqrt(N_ph)) photo-electrons, independent per bucket
noise_model.reading: B_noisy = (K + e) / s, signed, not clipped
noise_model.rng: noise generator = numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([pattern_seed, 4040, regime_index])); patterns from the established pattern_batches(seed); one noise draw for all 10,000 buckets of each (image, seed), so shot-count prefixes are nested

regime_rule.selection: half-decade photon budget whose median training fluctuation SNR is closest in log10 to target
regime_rule.revision: first version used whole decades only; it mapped LOW and MEDIUM onto the same budget (1e5; fluct SNR 5.9 vs 5.3), so the grid was refined to half-decades BEFORE any reconstruction was run
